# BashSnippets.xyz
> Free copy-paste bash scripts and interactive tools for Linux users, developers, and sysadmins.
> Every script is tested, explained in plain English, and copy-paste ready.

## Snippet Pages

- [Disk Space Warning](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/disk-space-warning.html): Bash script that monitors disk usage and alerts when it crosses a threshold. Runs on cron.
- [Kill a Process](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/kill-a-process.html): Use pkill and pgrep to kill Linux processes by name instead of hunting PIDs with ps aux.
- [Check If Website Is Up](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/check-if-website-is-up.html): curl returns an HTTP status code. 200 means up. Automate with cron every 5 minutes.
- [Delete Old Log Files](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/delete-old-log-files.html): find with -mtime deletes files older than N days. Safe, fast, cron-compatible.
- [Automated File Backup](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/automated-file-backup.html): cp -r with a timestamp. Backs up any directory on a schedule.
- [Search Files for Text](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/search-files-for-text-grep.html): grep -rn searches every file in a directory recursively with line numbers.
- [Monitor CPU & RAM Usage](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/monitor-cpu-ram-usage.html): Bash script that reports CPU load and memory usage. Useful for cron-based alerting.
- [Bash Error Handling](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/bash-error-handling.html): set -euo pipefail and trap patterns for bulletproof bash scripts.
- [MySQL Database Backup](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/mysql-database-backup.html): mysqldump with timestamped filenames and old backup rotation.
- [Restart Service If Stopped](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/restart-service-if-stopped.html): Check systemctl status and auto-restart a service with logging.
- [Create Dated Folder](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/create-dated-folder.html): mkdir with date formatting for organized timestamped directories.
- [Send Email Alert from Bash](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/bash-send-email-alert.html): Use mail or sendmail to send alert emails from bash scripts.
- [File Permissions & Security](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/file-permissions-security.html): chmod, chown, find -perm audit script for Linux file permission security.
- [SSH Key Setup Script](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/ssh-key-setup-script.html): Generate SSH keys and configure passwordless login with a single script.
- [Quick System Info Report](https://bashsnippets.xyz/snippets/quick-system-info-report.html): One-command snapshot of hostname, uptime, disk, memory, and IP.

## Interactive Tools

- [Bash Boilerplate Generator](https://bashsnippets.xyz/tools/bash-boilerplate-generator.html): Configure options and copy a production-ready .sh script template.
- [Bash Exit Code Lookup](https://bashsnippets.xyz/tools/bash-exit-code-lookup.html): Look up what any bash exit code means with explanations.
- [Cron Job Builder](https://bashsnippets.xyz/tools/cron-job-builder.html): Visual cron expression builder with plain-English output.
- [chmod Permissions Builder](https://bashsnippets.xyz/tools/chmod-permissions-builder.html): Toggle permission bits and get the chmod command instantly.
- [PATH Debugger](https://bashsnippets.xyz/tools/path-debugger.html): Paste your $PATH and find duplicates, missing directories, and issues.
- [Interactive Script Builder](https://bashsnippets.xyz/builder.html): Select options to generate a full custom bash script.

## About

Maintained by Anguishe. No login required. No paywall. All scripts tested on Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, and macOS. New scripts and tools added weekly.
